VisitorTestimonial.title: VisitorTestimonial
VisitorTestimonial.description: Public, non-PII reflection and experience shared by a first-time or returning visitor to Kathmandu Valley heritage sites.

id.description: Unique document ID matching the Firestore path variable.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified author who published the testimony.

visitorName.description: Display name chosen by the visitor.

originCountry.description: Home city or country of the visitor.

visitType.description: Whether this was the visitor's first time in Kathmandu or a return visit.

visitedSiteId.description: Slug or identifier of the visited Kathmandu heritage monument.

visitedSiteName.description: Readable title of the visited site.

visitDateLabel.description: Month and year of the visit.

headline.description: Concise title summarizing the visitor experience.

story.description: Detailed narrative of how the visit felt.

adviceForFirstTimers.description: Practical guidance for future first-time travelers.

visibility.description: Visibility scope enforced by Firestore list/get rules.

NewsletterSubscriber.title: NewsletterSubscriber
NewsletterSubscriber.description: Private email subscription record captured from the footer newsletter form for Kathmandu heritage site updates.

id.description: Unique subscriber document ID matching the Firestore path variable.

email.description: Lowercase trimmed email address submitted by the visitor.

locale.description: Active UI language code when the visitor subscribed.

NotablePlaceRecord.title: NotablePlaceRecord
NotablePlaceRecord.description: Administrator-curated additional Kathmandu Valley site or place worth visiting, published to the extended valley gazetteer.

id.description: Unique document ID matching the Firestore path variable.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified administrator who published the site.

name.description: Display title of the temple, courtyard, or heritage place.

image.description: Preset image identifier or watermark-free HTTPS image URL.

distanceKm.description: Distance from Central Kathmandu in kilometers.

walkingDistance.description: Walking trail duration and route note.

commodities.description: Bounded list (1 to 12) of nearby visitor commodities and facilities.

history.description: Historical background displayed in the History column.

visitingNote.description: Opening hours and courtyard etiquette note.

visibility.description: Public visibility scope enforced by Firestore rules.

ManagedHeritageSiteAction.title: ManagedHeritageSiteAction
ManagedHeritageSiteAction.description: Administrator-managed addition or removal override for the primary HERITAGE_SITES directory.

id.description: Unique document ID matching the Firestore path variable.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified administrator.

actionType.description: Whether this record adds a new heritage site or hides a built-in site.

targetSiteId.description: Slug identifier of the added or hidden heritage site.

name.description: Display name of the heritage site.

imageUrls.description: Bounded list (1 to 5) of primary and additional watermark-free image URLs or preset keys.

description.description: Architectural and historical description of the site.

district.description: District or municipality in the Kathmandu Valley.

visibility.description: Public read visibility enforced by Firestore rules.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the admin change.

/visitor_testimonials/{testimonialId}.description: Publicly readable community testimonials contributed by verified visitors sharing their first-time and returning experiences in Kathmandu Valley.

/newsletter_subscribers/{subscriberId}.description: Write-only visitor email subscriptions for heritage site dispatches, readable exclusively by the verified atlas administrator.

/notable_places/{placeId}.description: Publicly readable notable Kathmandu Valley places curated and managed exclusively by the verified administrator.

/managed_heritage_sites/{recordId}.description: Publicly readable administrator additions and removal overrides for the core HERITAGE_SITES directory, writable strictly by verified personnel.
